MRI Safety Information
Non-clinical testing has demonstrated that the Rhea Infusion Pump is MR Conditional. A patient with this device can be safely scanned in an MR system meeting the following conditions:
· Static magnetic field of 1.5 T
· Gradient slew rate limited to 150 T/m/s per axis
· Maximum MR system reported, whole body averaged specific absorption rate (SAR) of 0.4 W/kg (First Level Controlled Operating Mode)
· Maximum active scan time of 15 minutes
· Followed by a wait time of 15 minutes
· Any receive-only coil may be used
· Device configuration: Stimulation OFF
Under the scan conditions defined above, the Rhea Infusion Pump is expected to produce a maximum temperature rise of less than 3.0 °C after 15 minutes of continuous scanning.
RF heating was evaluated using a body coil at 64 MHz and 128 MHz in a gel phantom.
